family: GTK2 public Theme Lab route: Motif controller, coupled preview and detached preview

change.summary: No source change in R49. Recorded an integration validation of the current central C99/Motif controller path for the exercised GTK2 push/range scene.

validation.scope: Real Motif controller -> private GTK2 button/range generation and both previews
checks: Native GTK2 scene rendered in coupled and detached previews.
Apply changed the scene from 180x50 to 280x60 in both previews.
Turning detached preview off closed it while coupled preview remained.
Metrics from a closed preview origin were rejected; valid IPC was accepted and correlated.
validation.environment: Private Xvfb and bwrap; personal desktop/profile untouched. Internal private Xvfb attempt was inaccessible to the harness; rerunning under an owned Xvfb passed.

limits: This proves the central controller route only for the exercised GTK2 push/range scene and geometry lifecycle, not every control.
Does not prove visual equivalence to Domain/OS SR10.4 or HP VUE 2.01.
Does not validate the user profile, XChat, or GTK2 session installation.
next: Continue I167 GTK2 family audit; resolve remaining theme-controlled gaps and historical comparisons, then apply the completed GTK2 theme to the user session and XChat.
